findings.title: HMAC authentication with anti-replay
findings.summary: HMAC-SHA256 signature scheme with nonce replay protection, bodyHash binding, clock skew tolerance, and timing-safe comparison. Excellent internal microservice auth practice.

findings.title: Path traversal prevention via runtime root
findings.summary: resolve_runtime_path rejects absolute paths and verifies resolved path stays within RUNTIME_ROOT using parents containment check. Double defense against traversal attacks.

findings.title: Reader Facade pattern for scientific data
findings.summary: Protocol-based MeteorologicalDatasetReader abstraction with Facade router. Upper layer only constructs GridQuery; backend selection is delegated. Adding new formats just requires implementing the Protocol.

findings.title: Lazy imports for heavy scientific libraries
findings.summary: Functions like _np(), _xarray(), _rasterio() defer importing heavy libraries until first use. Avoids loading the full scientific stack at startup.

findings.title: Frozen dataclasses for immutable science models
findings.summary: GridQuery, GridSlice, MeteorologicalGrid use @dataclass(frozen=True) to prevent accidental mutation in complex processing pipelines.

findings.title: Third-party code provenance isolation
findings.summary: Original Flask apps preserved as read-only snapshots under source/original/. Clean adapters loaded via import_source_module without modifying originals.

findings.title: Constant-time comparison for secrets
findings.summary: Both signature verification and bodyHash comparison use hmac.compare_digest for timing-safe comparison, preventing side-channel attacks.

findings.title: Concurrency semaphore for resource control
findings.summary: asyncio.Semaphore(WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENCY) limits concurrent heavy array operations, preventing resource exhaustion on the worker.

findings.title: Graceful xarray-to-h5py fallback
findings.summary: When xarray fails to parse HDF5, falls back to h5py and preserves the original error as a warning rather than discarding it.

findings.title: Auto-detection of lat/lon coordinates
findings.summary: Multi-heuristic detection for geographic coordinates: normalized names, units strings, standard_name attributes. Covers diverse CF conventions used in meteorological data.

findings.title: Missing value normalization from NetCDF attrs
findings.summary: Reads _FillValue and missing_value attributes from datasets and systematically replaces them with NaN for consistent downstream processing.

findings.title: Structured nonce cache eviction
findings.summary: Nonce cache evicts by expiration time first, then oldest entries when over capacity, with reserve slots for the admission check.

findings.title: Authentication failures not logged
findings.summary: All auth failures (signature mismatch, expired nonce, replay, body hash mismatch) return 403 without logging the specific reason. Severely impedes security incident investigation.

findings.title: Bare except Exception in radar header parsing
findings.summary: except Exception: return defaults silently swallows ALL errors including file read failures, parse errors, and type conversion errors. Corrupted radar data goes undetected.

findings.title: struct.unpack without explicit endianness
findings.summary: Uses native byte order (unpack('i')) instead of explicit little-endian (<i) or big-endian (>i). Binary radar data from different hardware/regions may have differing endianness.

findings.title: Body size checked after full memory read
findings.summary: Middleware reads the entire request body into memory first, then checks size. A multi-gigabyte payload triggers OOM before the 413 response is generated.

findings.title: Env var parsing without validation
findings.summary: Direct int()/float() coercion of env vars without try/except. A malformed value crashes the worker at import time with ValueError. No bounds checking on concurrency or clock skew.

findings.title: setattr monkey-patching in tests
findings.summary: _set_module_attrs uses setattr to overwrite module globals. Test ordering matters and state leaks between cases despite setUp/tearDown.

findings.title: Hardcoded interval assumption in rainfall accumulation
findings.summary: time_weight = 5.0 / 60.0 hardcodes a 5-minute interval between NC files. If input cadence changes, rainfall totals are silently incorrect.

findings.title: Nonce cache lacks passive expiration
findings.summary: Nonce cache only purges expired entries during active request processing. If no requests arrive, expired nonces remain in memory indefinitely.

findings.title: No rate limiting on auth endpoint
findings.summary: HMAC auth verification runs on every request without any rate limiting, making brute-force attacks against the signature scheme theoretically possible.

findings.title: Exception-based engine selection discards traceback
findings.summary: Engine fallback loop catches exceptions but only collects messages. The first engine's full traceback is lost, making engine-specific debugging difficult.

findings.title: matplotlib.use Agg side effect in source import
findings.summary: matplotlib.use('Agg') is set at module import time in adapted code. Since imported via import_source_module, this side effect propagates to the host process.

findings.title: Redundant dispatch logic across service methods
findings.summary: File-format detection and backend routing in inspect() and read_grid() is nearly identical duplicated code. Adding a new format requires changes in multiple places.
